736:t_1:166.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Isn't that a little insensitive, $$クルツ$$?」

736:t_1:167.en:
$$宗介$$
「Leave him be. He's an unfortunate man who can only live in war.」

736:t_1:168.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I never thought I'd see the day when you said that to me.」

736:t_1:169.en:
$$宗介$$
「...True. I'm a little surprised myself.」

736:t_1:170.en:
$$カレン$$
「Having a woman in his life changes a man.」

736:t_1:171.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-what are you getting at, $$カレン$$...?」

736:t_1:172.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...The fact is, the turmoil on Earth will not settle down so easily.」

736:t_1:173.en:
$$マオ$$
「$c will probably disband when we get back to Earth. And $$ミスリル$$ itself is practically destroyed.」

736:t_1:174.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So, $$ゼロ$$... If you and your people are willing, why not join $$ミスリル$$?」

736:t_1:175.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Are you trying to recruit us?」

736:t_1:176.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$テッサ$$ said she'd be able to take it a little easier if you joined, $$ゼロ$$.」

736:t_1:177.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$テッサ$$ keeps complaining to us that she wants to be an ordinary girl again too.」

736:t_1:179.en:
$$クルツ$$
「People with shady pasts are pretty common in the mercenary world.」

736:t_1:180.en:
$$マオ$$
「We need more fighting strength to make up for $$宗介$$ leaving.」

736:t_1:182.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Well... Let's discuss that once this is over.」

736:t_1:183.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But listen, $$宗介$$... You decide how you live by your own will.」

736:t_1:184.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whatever you decide, we'll accept it.」

736:t_1:186.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$キリコ$$... Naturally, you will join $$ミスリル$$, won't you?」

736:t_1:187.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I have no intention of doing that.」

736:t_1:188.en:
$$マオ$$
「Hold on! That throws our plans completely off!」

736:t_1:189.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you were planning to fill $$宗介$$'s place with $$キリコ$$...」

736:t_1:190.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Seriously, $$キリコ$$!? Have you already signed up with some other mercenary group!?」

736:t_1:192.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ probably will not fight anymore.」

736:t_1:194.en:
$$カレン$$
「Living together with $$フィアナ$$... That's the life you've chosen, $$キリコ$$.」

736:t_1:195.en:
$$宗介$$
「If that is the answer he chose, no one can change his mind now.」

736:t_1:196.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... $$宗介$$... It's nice to feel free, but... might we be in danger of not graduating?」

736:t_1:198.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「W-we're in trouble, $$正太郎$$! What if we can't graduate either!?」

736:t_1:199.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Calm down, $$ワッ太$$. You'll be fine if you did the homework Miss $$美重子$$ assigned when the Galactic Raid Fleet set sail.」

736:t_1:200.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Th-then...! What if I haven't done it...?」

736:t_1:203.en:
$$柿小路$$
「This is no laughing matter, President!」

736:t_1:204.en:
$$厚井$$
「It's true there hasn't been time to finish homework, but...」

736:t_1:205.en:
$$郁絵$$
「But if $$正太郎$$ did his, we can't make excuses.」

736:t_1:206.en:
$$木下$$
「Don't tell me you'll stay an elementary school president forever...」

736:t_1:207.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I don't want that! I want to graduate with $$かおる$$, $$正太郎$$, and the others too!」

736:t_1:208.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't push it, $$ワッ太$$. The way you are now, there's no way you could keep up with junior high classes.」

736:t_1:210.en:
$$恵子$$
「Don't make $$ワッ太$$ worry like that...!」

736:t_1:211.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「C-can't we do something...? You know... like use $$真化融合$$ with my homework and get all the answers in a flash...」

736:t_1:212.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Of course that is impossible. The homework's righteous heart would oppose such cheating.」

736:t_1:214.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Fighting alongside us has given $$グーラ$$ a heart that won't tolerate evil too.」

736:t_1:215.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$ワッ太$$... If you have a righteous heart, face your homework fair and square.」

736:t_1:216.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「If you put it that way, a man like $$竹尾ワッ太$$ can't back down!」

736:t_1:217.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Before the big showdown for humanity's future, I'll knock out a little homework!」

736:t_1:218.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do your best, $$ワッ太$$. I'll help with anything you don't understand.」

736:t_1:219.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then I'm counting on you for all of it...」

736:t_1:220.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...At this rate, the universe's great collapse might come first...」

736:t_1:221.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I won't let that happen! I'll tackle the battle and my homework!」

736:t_1:222.en:
$$いぶき$$
「It seems elementary school kids have their own troubles.」

736:t_1:223.en:
$$青山$$
「Even things that seem trivial to us adults are a big deal to them.」

736:t_1:224.en:
$$赤木$$
「But adults have it tough too. Even if peace comes to the universe, disasters will still happen... We have to prepare for them.」

736:t_1:225.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?」

736:t_1:226.en:
$$青山$$
「She's right. Our next enemy has power on a completely different scale from anything we've faced.」

736:t_1:227.en:
$$赤木$$
「It'll be fine! No... I'll make sure it'll be fine!」

736:t_1:228.en:
$$赤木$$
「When we're old and look back on our youth, I'm sure even the next battle will just be something we remember as 'Oh, that happened too.'」

736:t_1:229.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It's tiresome to think battles like this might keep happening...」

736:t_1:230.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「But life goes on. The Show Must Go On.」

736:t_1:231.en:
$$赤木$$
「How about it, $$ロジャー$$? Want to put your negotiating skills to work at $$２１世紀警備保障$$?」

736:t_1:232.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You are headhunting me? It feels good to have my work appreciated.」

736:t_1:233.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ロジャー$$... What about our plan to become private detectives together?」

736:t_1:234.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You invited me too, $$万丈$$. Both offers are appealing.」

736:t_1:236.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have no intention of deciding here.」

736:t_1:237.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Are you not confident you'll come back?」

736:t_1:238.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That isn't it. I just want to enjoy the possibilities ahead... what you might call freedom... to the fullest.」

736:t_1:239.en:
$$万丈$$
「This battle is against those who stand in the way of that freedom... We will win our future.」

736:t_1:240.en:
$$ランカ$$
「We're going to the $$バジュラ$$ planet, aren't we?」

736:t_1:241.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Yes. It's an Earth-like planet, and the $$フロンティア船団$$ has the right to settle it as its first discoverers.」

736:t_1:243.en:
$$オズマ$$
「But that comes after we overcome the crisis facing the universe.」

736:t_1:244.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「We have to face the $$御使い$$s... and the universe's great collapse...」

736:t_1:245.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「The immortal $$御使い$$s are trouble enough, and we don't even know how to stop the universe's great collapse...」
